comment: ANCHOR: REENTRY_CONFIRMED_GATE_1643_20261109 — a re-entry is Confirmed only when Stage 1 is complete AND a Stage 2 price check passes; a price check over an incomplete Stage 1 reads "Price recovered" with how much of Stage 1 is done (operator 2026-11-09, option 1: they were shown CONFIRMED at 0-1 of 5 and asked "buy now?").
